newsitem.title: USA: Arthur J. Gallagher buys two companies.
newsitem.headline: Arthur J. Gallagher buys two companies.

text.p: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co said Tuesday it paid an undisclosed amount to acquire two insurance benefit consulting companies in Michigan and Colorado.
Arnold & Co of Troy, Michigan, will merge its operations with Gallagher ABOW Inc, a Gallagher & Co subsidiary.
Byerly & Company of Denver, Colorado, will become a unit of Gallagher Benefits Services of Colorado.
Gallagher is an international insurance brokerage and risk management services firm with 153 offices in seven countries.
Its shares were unchanged Tuesday at 30.
